notes.title: Artisan TD 1.3: The Prince Mode update has arrived!
notes.notes:
Super patch 1.3 and Artisan TD Demo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/7bca4ad399dc758435387d37a9c88cec13f5e860.png

Hello everyone!

We are very happy to present to you patch 1.3. Thanks to your feedback, we understood some players wanted a tower defense with more freedom, and that is less punishing. Thus, we wanted to meet that need by creating the Prince mode!
Available in the three difficulty settings, this new mode allows a more relaxed experience, closer to the traditionnal tower defense spirit. With that said, if you appreciate the “puzzle” and “die and retry” philosophy of the original game, rest assured: you can keep playing the classic mode.

Have fun and don't hesitate to send us your feedback!


Content Addition

New Prince Mode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/f25ac668f2b47b11ca2613cc30cb9aef2329d016.png
Play like a prince in the difficulty setting of your choice!
👑 Royal support: +50% more starting coins.
👑 Royal bank: +10% more interest at the end of each wave.
👑 Royal archers: +1 damage per archer, and they pick a new target with each shot.

New board "Final Cloud"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/03c321be828b833dbab93feda8efa0ba44770504.png
Unlock the "Final Cloud" board after triumphing over Clouds 1, 2, 3.

New achievement: Octogolem

New boss!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/89aee9f453cfb3dafd9c631cbc3336edddeb6e68.png
Will you defeat the Octogolem?

Unlock tips!
Tips are now available to see in game in the settings.
Do not hesitate to check them out.

UI changes:
New pictogram on totems for classic nightmare victory.
Fix - Nightmare mode color change.

More:
Board 7 - Modifications to Adventurer and Veteran difficulties.
Bonus 1 - Lighting change.
Victory screen slightly modified.
Pause screen slightly modified.
Fix - Turkish 100% translated (some texts were missing).
Fix - Behavior of exclamation marks highlighting new features.
Fix - Info zone initialization at map launch.
Fix - Gamepad button sprites on SteamDeck.


[hr][/hr]
New free Demo!

Discover and try the game on 7 boards!

notes.title: Artisan TD 1.2: The Floating Ruins update has arrived!
notes.notes:
The Floating Ruins update has arrived!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/b0fdf92044ca6199c04cba350a23f530d90a0a18.png

Hello dear explorers.

Thanks to your many feedbacks, we were able to identify and resolve several frustrating aspects of the game, particularly regarding balancing and the lack of explanations for certain mechanics. Your constructive criticism has greatly helped us make improvements and make Artisan TD more accessible and enjoyable.
A big thank you for your support!

We have added tips to better explain strategies and adjusted difficulty levels. We are also offering 3 new boards and a new power, Quick Shot, which allows a tower to instantly fire and reset its targeting, usable multiple times per wave. At the same time, we optimized several technical aspects: full controller support, improved zoom, DLSS/FSR support, and rebalancing of towers and waves on certain maps.

We look forward to your feedback and will continue to improve the game.

For the honor and glory of the Artisan Guild!

Content Addition

3 New Boards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/cc6542e7aa66c57cb06faeb05bd503507089103b.png

[hr][/hr]

Patch v1.2

🧩 New:

 3 bonus boards. (unlocked at boards 8, 18, and 28)
 Quick Shot: In-game power that recharges with each wave.
 Tips screen filled with useful advice.
 Full controller support.
 DLSS 2.2 & FSR 1.0 available.
 3 new Steam achievements.

📐 Balancing:

 The resale rate in “Veteran” difficulty has been increased from 50% to 75%.
 Wave balancing fixes (maps 9 & 11). 
 Flamethrower: Burns stronger for a shorter duration for better efficiency. 
 Ray: Increased damage and range. 
 Darts: Increased frequency. 
 Arbalist: Slight increase in fire rate. 
 Arbalist Elite: Slight range increase. 
 Catapult: Slight splash damage increase. 
 Tower rotation reset between each wave. 
 
🔨 Bug Fixes: 
 
 Fixed a crash bug after the defeat popup. 
 Controller: Fixed navigation through holes. 
 Controller: Monster arrival vibration no longer triggers when using the mouse. 
 Controller: Information displayed when changing difficulty. 
 Controller: Adjusted ergonomics and feel. 
 UI: Button logic fixed.

✨ Polish: 
 
 Improved camera control when zoom is active.
 Improved rebind options menus.
 Monster health bars hidden when the game is paused.
 Graphical improvements on board 12.
 Environment touch-ups for zooming.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44825158/745843a1806b7a707faceffd04dc0e8dbe128c05.png Trading cards and point shop items are now available!
